context: Yumiko guides Sho through morning routine.
purpose: Casual home register; adverbs (きちんと/とりあえず/どうしても/通常/決して) in natural home.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 正坊、歯はきちんと磨いた?
lines.en: Sho, did you brush your teeth properly?
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm caring asking throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!でも、どうしても眠いよ。
lines.en: Yeah! But I'm just so sleepy.
lines.style: drowsy small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: とりあえず、顔を洗ってきなさい。
lines.en: For now, go wash your face.
lines.style: gentle mother voice, soft warm gently urging throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 通常の朝より、早いんだもん。
lines.en: It's earlier than a usual morning!
lines.style: pouty small child voice, bright warm whining delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 決して、遅刻はさせないわよ。
lines.en: I will absolutely not let you be late.
lines.style: firm mother voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: とりあえず、ご飯食べる!
lines.style: energetic small child voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: きちんと食べて、元気に行きましょう。
lines.en: Eat properly and go off with energy.
lines.style: warm mother voice, soft warm affectionate delivery throughout

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん!決して泣かずに頑張る!
lines.en: Yeah! I'll try hard and not cry at all!
lines.style: determined small child voice, bright warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
